camera.shot_scale_bias: medium shots that include the whole room
camera.height: seated height, level with the people in frame

lens.dof: moderate focus keeping the domestic space readable behind

lighting.practicals: the light is whatever the room has, soft and unmodelled

rules: people framed within doorways and around low tables
composition.movement_of_subject: ordinary domestic activity continues while people talk

sound.ambience_bias: kitchen sounds, cicadas, a television in another room, traffic outside

music.instrumentation: A simple piano figure with light strings
music.dynamics: entering late and staying quiet under the scene

must_include: the camera sits at the height of people seated on the floor
ordinary domestic detail is left visible in the frame
avoid: camera movement for its own sake

notes: Domestic interiors at seated height, available light, long patient takes of ordinary activity.
